newsitem.title: USA: Interfoods says may seek to raise debt.
newsitem.headline: Interfoods says may seek to raise debt.

text.p: Interfoods of America Inc said Friday it may seek to raise capital through debt or equity financing for acquisitions.
The company said it plans to acquire other food brands to match with its Sobiks Subs brand in a co-branding environment.
Additionally, the company may acquire or build more Popeyes Chicken restaurants as opportunities present themselves.
In order to accomplish its goals the company may seek to raise capital through debt and/or equity financing, it said.
There can be no assurance, that when the company seeks capital, that capital will be available on terms and conditions acceptable to the company, Interfoods said.
Interfoods said it is optimistic that all of its goals for 1997 will be met before the close of its fiscal year in September.

The company had a net income of $93,528 and $135,058 for the three and nine months ended June 30, 1997 compared with net losses of $204,677 and $295,613 for the three and nine months ended June 30, 1996.

The company said the profitable turnaround during this quarter is attributable to the increase in top line revenues and cost savings from the consolidation of the corporate offices to one location in Miami.
